title: Coherent universal derived extension preserves distinguished triangles
statement: For a universal left derived extension L of scalars R to B with a counit and compatible coherent integer shift, the composite from A-complexes through restriction to R, the homotopy quotient, Qh and L sends every distinguished image triangle to a distinguished triangle.

proof.text: For every R-complex obtain an exhaustive split filtered-free resolution from lem-pc-large-filtered-free-resolution and apply lem-pc-filtered-free-kprojective. Let P be the homotopy-category objects represented by K-projective complexes. Quotient the resolution maps to get a quasi-isomorphism from an object of P to every homotopy-category object.

Use Mathlib CochainComplex.IsKProjective.quasiIso_iff to show that quasi-isomorphisms between representatives of objects of P are homotopy equivalences. Their homotopy quotients are isomorphisms, so ordinary homotopy scalar extension followed by Qh_B inverts them. This does not require flatness of B.

Apply lem-pur-quasi-isos-saturated-triangulated for the saturated triangulated multiplicative system and its right fraction calculus and two-out-of-three. Apply lem-pur-resolving-class-essential-constancy to P to obtain everywhere-defined denominator values. Apply lem-pur-left-derived-kan-source-triangles to the supplied L, its given shift structure, and the supplied shift-compatible universal counit. This proves that Qh_R followed by L preserves distinguished source triangles. Mathlib isTriangulated_of_precomp descends triangulatedness along Qh_R, whose arrow functor is essentially surjective.

Restriction of scalars is exact; Mathlib mapDerivedCategory gives its triangulated functor D(A) to D(R). Apply its composite with L to the distinguished image of T under Q_A. Compose mapDerivedCategoryFactors, quotientCompQhIso, associators, and mapTriangleCompIso to identify this triangle with the displayed composite image. All these comparisons commute with the given shifts, so this includes the third arrow. Closure of distinguished triangles under isomorphism gives the claim. The construction keeps the independently chosen morphism universes of D(R), D(A), D(B) and works for zero rings and unbounded complexes.
